route_summary: One attempt (001, effectively blind). Two-phase HS attainment and Milton's 1981 attainability rule (HS_lo <= sigma2, equivalently m1 >= 2*Theta*(1-m2)) re-derived exactly in Q; the classical assemblage is infeasible on m11 <= m1 < 2*Theta*(1-m2), where Cherkaev's 2009 bound is plain HS. A bounded-rank census there finds a rank-4 laminate 5.5e-4 above HS at f=(1,1,6)/8, sigma=(1,2,5). Open: does some finite rank attain HS on that interval (001 leads 1-2). Read 001 for the constructions and the screen-then-certify pipeline.

attempts.one_line: Exact two-phase HS attainment and the Milton (1981) three-phase attainability rule rediscovered and certified in Q; in the region where the assemblage fails and Cherkaev's bound is plain HS, an exhaustive rank-3/rank-4 laminate screen gets within 5.5e-4 of HS_lo, with every winner certified exactly and verified by the second implementation.
attempts.range: Two-phase: 3 conductivity pairs x 5 fractions, exact. Milton rule: grids k/8 at sigma=(1,2,5), k/40 at (1,3,20), k/30 at (1/7,5/3,101/2), plus 19924 random exact instances for the equivalence with m1 >= 2 Theta (1-m2). Screen: rank 3 over four normals (11520 topologies) at the k/8 grid for sigma=(1,2,5) both sides and gap-region points for (1,3,20); rank 4 with axis normals (33600 topologies) at five gap points; seed 1, 2 restarts. 27 certified records.
gaps: Nesi 1995's bound was not transcribed (paywalled); which published bound is tightest at the census points is unresolved.
Whether Albin-Cherkaev-Nesi 2007 or Cherkaev 2009 exhibit a structure attaining HS on m11 <= m1 < 2 Theta (1-m2) was not settled.
Rank-4 screen used axis normals and two restarts only; its value is an upper estimate of the rank-4 optimum.
The Milton attribution rests on two secondary sources; the 1981 paper itself was not reached.
Screens at fixed rank are evidence about that rank and normal set, not about all microstructures.
attempts.note: Mode is informed only because the director read STATUS.md and docs/CYCLE.md; the problem had no attempts, so the attempt is effectively blind. Work was delegated to four Sonnet subagents (certifier, screener, shape analyst, literature skeptic) briefed on tier-0 material and this attempt's own scripts; the director verified the Milton-equivalence algebra and the exactness checks itself.
